verdicts.reason: A gives the tiny logo a wide, mostly empty white panel. Its 'Reserve a Case' pill is so small that the label is cramped and barely legible, and the 'Ships late June' note under it looks about as big, so the call to action is lost. The body copy is also tiny and squeezed against the bottom edge. B gives the CTA a large, readable orange button and a tighter logo panel, so the hierarchy works better. B is still flawed: the orange divider sits awkwardly at the left, almost touching the body copy, and the body text is cramped against the bottom edge. Also, the 'LIMITED SUMMER RELEASE' tag is spaced much wider than in the original.
